subject: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@artemis.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the demo interest. We'd like to run a focused technical deep-dive that doubles as a planning session for a short load test: two hours where we validate token throughput targets and latency SLOs for your core inference path.

Goals:
- Walk architecture assumptions (model variant, max sequence, batching behavior)
- Run a staged load profile (ramp -> steady -> spike) to validate token/sec and p95 latency
- Agree on success criteria and follow-ups (e.g., quantization recommendation, cache hints)

Proposed windows (PST):
1) Thu Sep 23, 09:00–11:00
2) Fri Sep 24, 13:00–15:00
3) Mon Sep 27, 07:00–09:00 (early slot if you have APAC team)

Prework requested from your side:
- A short list of representative prompts/patterns (we can accept a CSV)
- Peak concurrent user estimate and expected average sequence length
- Any firewall/IP allowlist constraints for short-run load generation

I've attached a brief benchmark_spec_v2.pdf and our redwood_runbook.xlsx (run steps + rollback). If one of the windows works, reply with your preferred slot and we’ll send calendar invites and a tentative runbook.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: benchmark_spec_v2.pdf (1.8MB PDF)]
[Attachment: redwood_runbook.xlsx (150KB spreadsheet)]

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@artemis.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Cc: ops@artemis.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:34:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the outline. We're very interested and would like to prioritize a thorough throughput validation, especially p95 under burst. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Target throughput goal: ~1.8M tokens/hour sustained for the conversational endpoint, with peak bursts up to 3.2M tokens/hour for short windows.
- Average sequence length: ~220 tokens; 99th pct length ~1,200
- We have a security window on Thu 23rd 10:00–11:00 for an internal board review, so the first proposed window conflicts for key stakeholders.

Fri Sep 24 13:00–15:00 looks best for us (PST), but can you confirm you have a test harness that supports our spike profile (short ramp to peak for 10 minutes)? Also please share the IPs your load generator will use so we can open allowlists.

I'll upload a short sample prompt set to a temporary bucket and share.

—Tom
Tom Ellis
VP Product, Artemis Robotics
[tom.ellis@artemis.ai]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@artemis.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework

Putting engineering notes here — Naomi asked me to confirm capacity and runbook availability.

We can support the Fri Sep 24 13:00–15:00 slot. Quick checklist for run success:
- Load harness: our internal harness supports burst profiles (ramp Xs -> peak Ys). Need the sample prompt CSV and expected QPS per client.
- Model variant: confirm whether you're testing 8-bit quantized variant or FP16. Quantized paths change memory and kernel selection; call it out in the prework.
- KV cache warmup: for conversational endpoints we need an initial warmup period to populate KV cache — recommend 5 min at 30% load before the main ramp.

Attached: preliminary test matrix and the specific IP ranges for the run generator so Tom's team can allowlist.

[Attachment: redwood_runbook.xlsx (updated with IP ranges)]

If Fri works, Naomi — please send a calendar invite with a joining link and we will create a dedicated channel for live logs.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sr. Perf Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@artemis.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework

Thanks Aditya — Fri 24th 13:00–15:00 PST confirmed on our side. I've uploaded the sample prompts here: https://artemis-secure-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/sample_prompts_v1.csv and shared the expected client QPS matrix in the same folder.

I also attached our internal prework note (ops@artemis.ai) with firewall rules. We'll allowlist the IPs you sent. Expecting to use the FP16 variant for the test; we can try a quick quantized run as an optional follow-up.

Can you include a 10-minute KV warmup and a 10-minute spike window (10 min ramp to peak, 10 min steady, 5 min cooldown) in the runbook?

—Tom
[Attachment: art_sample_prework.txt (3KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@artemis.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive + load testing: propose windows and prework

Great — Fri Sep 24, 13:00–15:00 PST is booked. I've sent a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) to all participants and added a short agenda in the invite: architecture walk (15m), run prep (15m), warmup + main run (40m), readouts + next steps (10m).

Action items before the run:
- Tom: confirm sample_prompts_v1.csv access and confirm expected QPS per client (done)
- Artemis ops: ensure allowlist is applied to our IPs (Aditya attached ranges)
- Aditya/Eng: prepare the KV warmup and spike profile as discussed; post an abbreviated runbook to the shared Drive link

Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD_RUNBOOK

I'll be on the call to coordinate; Marissa will capture notes and follow-ups. If anything changes, please reply-all.

Thanks and see you Friday —
Naomi
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
